assumptions.formula: P(creature per cast) = P(catch | rod pool) × P(creature | catch, Sheet C weights)
assumptions.note: Baseline steady-state only. Live rates change with wonder gates, collection progress, and pity.

creatures.name: Puddle Dart
creatures.description: A coin-bright fish that skims just below the surface, startled by its own reflection

creatures.name: Bubble Mote

creatures.name: Moss Skipper

creatures.name: Spark Pebble

creatures.name: Reed Tail

creatures.name: Cloud Fin

creatures.name: Hinge Glider
creatures.description: A jointed fish that folds mid-swim, changing direction with the ease of a door hinge

creatures.name: Amber Ring

creatures.name: Shore Ghost

creatures.name: Knot Swimmer
